scope: Two controlled FLUX.1 Kontext Dev repair points for BUS_06 and BUS_09 only. The official flux_kontext_qualifier_v1 remains immutable and is not rerun, modified, replaced, or ranked.

identity.limitation: The reused working Kontext graph has one connected primary identity input. REF01 remains the same frontal canonical reference as qualifier v1.

generation.resolution_policy: Reuse FluxKontextImageScale native output; do not resize, crop, upscale or retouch after generation.
generation.negative_conditioning: ConditioningZeroOut from the existing qualifier graph. It supplies no editable text-negative field, so the repair changes only positive prompt wording.

prompt_changes.common: Ensure realistic adult male body proportions, with the head naturally proportional to shoulders and torso; balanced anatomy, natural masculine shoulder width, correct perspective, and a realistic corporate photoshoot look. Avoid oversized head or bobblehead appearance.
prompt_changes.BUS_06: Use a realistic medium shot showing the visible head, shoulders, torso, arms, and hands; the head must not dominate the frame and the upper body must be naturally proportioned.
prompt_changes.BUS_09: Create a realistic full-body portrait with the full figure visible from head to shoes at a natural standing distance. The face occupies a naturally small portion of the frame; the head is proportional to torso and legs. Avoid short body, tiny torso, narrow shoulders, and wide-angle distortion.
